t: Microsoft Global Outage Affects Philippine Judiciary - Supreme Court
d: Global outage of Microsoft Outlook, Teams and wider Microsoft 365 services has affected the Philippine judiciary, the Supreme Court of the Philippines said on Friday.

t: Over 4,000 Foreign Mercenaries Fighting for Ukraine - Russian Investigative Committee
d: The Russian Investigative Committee said on Friday that it had data on more than 4,000 mercenaries from over 70 countries fighting for Ukraine.

t: Most French Pessimistic About Future of Democracy in France - Poll
d: Only 21% of the French are optimistic about the future of democracy in their country, an annual opinion report GLOBSEC Trends 2026 showed on Friday.
